platform: macOS ARM64, unoptimized Rust test build
method: Same instrumented test binary; tracing disabled during measurements. Plan is a test-feature prototype selected per process. Each scan uses the Locality mode at HummockVersionReader, vnode-zero keys, committed SSTs, exact range and row/value assertions. No Locality/Join executor, row deserialization or real S3 backend is run. Point latency is timed independently at SstableStore. Cache initialization uses eight workers as an explicit local assumption; the SF10 record does not identify that runtime worker count.
decision: Discard timer and range-plan prototypes. Keep current scheduling semantics, opt-in diagnostics, and ignored experiment. A preplanned range can duplicate bytes owned by an existing Foyer producer. No Foyer, Range or decode changes retained.
